notes: kb/Work PB367 (LANDED), PB367b (LANDED). Rule text (cite.py --check 14.9.49.4 "The declarative is invoked just before the named report group is produced" -> OK, GR 8). ALL SEVEN GROUP TYPES ARE NOW WITNESSED, not covered by reading: UseBeforeReporting_Gr8_EveryGroupTypeInvokesItsOwnDeclarative gives RH / PH / CH / DE / CF / PF / RF one declarative each, each writing its OWN digit into the item every group SOURCEs, so a group can print its own digit only if ITS declarative ran immediately before IT was produced - the printed report is RH 1 / PH 2 / CH 3 / DE 4 / CF 5 / PF 6 / RF 7, in the order 14.9.16.4 GR4 a)-d), 14.9.46.4 GR3 b)/c) and 13.18.57.4 GR6 f) require. THE PRESENT WHEN EDGE IS ADJUDICATED as an implementor determination and pinned: the declarative runs BEFORE the group's PRESENT WHEN conditions are evaluated. 14.9.49.4 GR9 d) performs the declarative 'Before the processing of any LINE clauses defined for the report group' and 13.18.41.4 GR2 evaluates condition-1 'before the processing of any LINE clauses for the report group' - the same boundary, with no rule ordering them, both before the page fit test - so the order is the implementor's; it is settled this way because the reverse makes the declarative's execution depend on data the declarative exists to set, and a level-01 PRESENT WHEN would silently suppress the procedure that would have made the group present. UseBeforeReporting_PresentWhen_DeclarativeRunsBeforeTheConditionIsEvaluated is the witness (the group is absent until its own declarative makes it present) and the determination is recorded in REPORT_WRITER_DESIGN's PRESENT WHEN row. || EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED: 1985/2002/2014/2023 (FORMAT 2, the Report Writer facility).
